output.explanation: The birth date field had a hidden technical name (fld_seinengappi_01) that overrode the visible caption, so screen readers read that code. The caption was changed from a plain div to a real label linked to the input, and the hidden code name was removed. Screen readers now read 生年月日, and clicking the caption focuses the field. The look is unchanged because the same lbl class is kept.
